title: artemisia arborescens f. rehan
intro: Artemisia arborescens f. rehan, commonly known as White Sage, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region, known for its distinctive white-gray foliage and small yellow flowers. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of White Sage are attributed to its ability to relax and calm the mind and body, promoting a sense of well-being and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which work together to provide a range of therapeutic benefits.
